content.title: Jefferies initiates Pony AI at Buy as China’s robotaxi market scales
content.summary: Investing.com -- Jefferies initiated coverage of Pony Ai Inc (NASDAQ:PONY) with a Buy rating and $32.8 price target, citing the company’s leadership in China’s robotaxi transition from pilot to scale. The brokerage said Pony is positioned to capture up to 30% of the domestic market long term, as the industry expands from a RMB52 billion total addressable market in 2030 to RMB1 trillion by 2040.
